evidences.evidence_quote: Location attribute calibration of mmWave radar. As mmWave radar is adaptable to various kinds of bad weather, it is first widely used in the field of autonomous driving as a complement to vision and LIDAR [80]. As a result, most of the current location attribute calibration works for mmWave radar are serving for autonomous driving [16, 23, 31, 35, 38–41, 76].
